brief: Logplex source of a Heroku log line.

enum_values.brief: Output written by the application's own processes, such as app[web.1].
Messages from the Heroku platform and router, such as heroku[router].

additional_context: Taken from the syslog APP-NAME header that Logplex sets on every drained line, such as app[web.1] or heroku[router].
Only set on Cedar, since Fir does not use Logplex.
